title: (As Leslie) Pick-up and the daily report
titleFa: (در نقش Leslie) تحویل عصر و گزارش روزانه

branches.suggestion: Hi, Mehdi! It's strange seeing you here! How was William today?
branches.suggestionFa: سلام {you}! عجیبه اینجا می‌بینمت! ویلیام امروز چطور بود؟

r2.speaker: mehdi
r2.text: Hi, Leslie! He had a great day.

translations.fa: سلام لزلی! روز خیلی خوبی داشت.

branches.suggestion: Lovely! Did he eat his lunch? He's been fussy at home this week.
branches.suggestionFa: چه خوب! ناهارش را خورد؟ این هفته تو خونه بدغذایی می‌کنه.

r3.speaker: mehdi
r3.text: Yes, he ate all of it and had seconds!

translations.fa: آره، همه‌ش را خورد و دوباره هم گرفت!

branches.suggestion: Ha, typical! And did he have a nap?

r4.speaker: mehdi
r4.text: Yes, he slept for an hour, from one to two.

translations.fa: آره، یه ساعت خوابید، از یک تا دو.

r5.speaker: william
r5.text: Mummy! I made a rocket! A big one!

translations.fa: مامان! یه موشک ساختم! یه بزرگش!

r6.speaker: mehdi
r6.text: He made it from boxes this morning.

branches.suggestion: Wow, it's brilliant! Any toilet accidents today?

r7.speaker: mehdi
r7.text: No accidents — he told us every time.

translations.fa: هیچ خیس‌کاری‌ای — هر بار بهمون گفت.

branches.suggestion: Fantastic. Thanks, Mehdi. You sound like a real nursery practitioner already!
branches.suggestionFa: فوق‌العاده. ممنون {you}. همین الان مثل یه مربی مهد واقعی حرف می‌زنی!
